Ultimate Butterfly Flurry (1110203) enters Amplification and deals #1 L10 720% of ATK. Talent Resurgence (1110204) #1 L10 = 80% DMG bonus for #4 = 3 turns on kill; Notes: the Extra Turn is queued alongside other Ultimates and Extra Turns at the end of the queue. requirements.claim: Basic ATK Thwack (1110201, Quantum) is the kit's Basic and fires in the fixture.
Sheathed Blade (1110202) is Seele's damaging Skill action; the fixture casts it 5 times in seele1.
Seele's kit exposes Basic ATK, Skill and Ultimate as its action set; she never falls back to a generic attack action.
Butterfly Flurry (1110203) is Seele's Ultimate action; the fixture casts it twice.
Butterfly Flurry #1 = 720% of ATK at L10 (1110203) in a single hit.
Thwack (1110201) totals 100% of ATK at the engine's default Basic Lv6 (canon L10 = 140%); the engine delivers its 2 hits with a 30% opening hit (0.3).
Sheathed Blade #1 = 360% of ATK at L10 (1110202); the engine delivers it over 4 hits with a 20% opening hit (0.72).
5 Skill casts in seele1 x 4 hits each = 20 Sheathed Blade damage events.
2 Basic ATKs in seele1 x 2 hits each = 4 Thwack damage events.
In seele-kill 5 Sheathed Blade casts resolve under the normal label (20 damage events of 4 hits each); the Resurgence free cast uses the (Auto) label.
The Resurgence-class automatic Skill resolves under a distinct 'Sheathed Blade (Auto)' label in seele-kill (4 damage events, full 4-hit cast).
The automatic Skill uses the same Sheathed Blade ladder: 360% total at L10 with a 20% opening hit (0.72).
Resurgence (1110204): the automatic Skill resolves strictly after an enemy is defeated by Seele, as a free extra-turn action.
Butterfly Flurry (1110203) enters Seele's Amplification state, lasting #4 = 3 turns via Resurgence (1110204).
Amplification increases all DMG dealt by Seele by #1 = 80% at L10 (1110204).
While Amplification is active Seele ignores 25% of the target's Quantum RES (bonus A2).
After Seele uses her Skill, SPD increases by 25% for 3 turns (bonus A4 Whistle).
The post-Skill SPD bonus is +25% SPD (bonus A4 Whistle).
After Seele uses Basic ATK her action is Advanced Forward by 20% (bonus A4 Whistle); 2 Basic ATKs in seele1 produce 2 advances.
The Basic-ATK advance value is 20% (bonus A4 Whistle).
Seele's Ultimate uses the standard Energy ladder; in seele1 her action set regenerates exactly 245 Energy.
In seele-kill she regenerates exactly 245 Energy (the Resurgence free auto Skill gains no energy, 1110202 Notes).
Each Sheathed Blade costs 1 Skill Point; 5 Skill casts in seele1 spend 5 SP.
Skill Point economy: 5 paid Skill casts spend 1 SP each; the Resurgence free auto Skill consumes no SP (1110202 Notes: the auto Skill 'does not consume Skill Points or regenerate Energy').
After an enemy is defeated by Seele she gains DMG +50% for 3 turns (bonus A1 Lingering Shrike).
Lingering Shrike's bonus is +50% DMG (bonus A1).
The post-Skill SPD buff is applied during the Skill action before the first Sheathed Blade damage resolves.
Butterfly Flurry enters the Amplification state — the Amplification buff is applied after the Ultimate's damage resolves.
Lingering Shrike applies after the killing blow: the enemy dies first, then the DMG +50% buff lands.
Resurgence (1110204) grants Seele an Extra Turn after defeating an enemy: an EXTRA_TURN event is emitted and the follow-up executes as the free (Auto) Skill (canon 1110202: no SP, no Energy).
